repository.name: Business Intel
repository.purpose: Evidence-safe public-signal lead intelligence, contact-route research, CRM enrichment, reporting, and controlled agent operations for 1BT.
limitations: The catalog describes semantic capabilities rather than listing every source file.
Cloud resources not checked live in this review remain observed rather than verified.
Ignored runtime leads, credentials, logs, and private evidence are intentionally excluded.

components.name: Business Intel Workspace Distribution
components.purpose: Package the repository's local operator application, Google ADK applications, shared libraries, operational tools, and static assets as one reviewed Python distribution.

environment.configuration_status: local defaults with separately gated optional integrations

evidence.detail: Canonical package, dependency, optional-extra, build, and tool configuration for the repository.

limitations: The distribution groups several capabilities; each deployable surface retains its own explicit release gate.

components.name: Sri Lanka Contact Search Agent
components.purpose: Search public web evidence for named contact routes used by the Contact Resolver.

evidence.detail: Module-level exported Google ADK Agent named contact_search_agent.

limitations: Search results remain candidates until source and person identity checks pass.

components.name: Contact Resolver Agent
components.purpose: Resolve role-first, evidence-led public contact routes for verified leads without sending outreach.

evidence.detail: Module-level exported contact_resolver_agent and its no-send contract.
Contact resolution architecture and output contract.

limitations: It does not send email or convert inferred addresses into verified contact evidence.

components.name: Gmail Sender Agent
components.purpose: Validate the locked local Gmail test-message path while refusing lead outreach and arbitrary recipients.

environment.configuration_status: local OAuth required for approved smoke path

evidence.detail: Module-level exported email_sender_agent with real sending disabled.

limitations: Lead outreach, arbitrary recipients, and bulk sending remain disabled.

components.name: 1BT Opportunity Analyst
components.purpose: Classify verified Sri Lankan leads into 1BT service buckets and propose evidence-bounded response strategies.

evidence.detail: Module-level exported opportunity_analyst using the 1BT service taxonomy.

limitations: It does not turn free text into a verified lead or confirmed opportunity.

components.name: Sri Lanka Trigger Leads Root Agent
components.purpose: Orchestrate verified Sri Lankan public-signal discovery, scoring, source recovery, opportunity analysis, contact resolution, and guarded test-email behavior.

evidence.detail: Exported root_agent named sl_trigger_leads with explicit sub-agent composition and real-data rules.

limitations: Tender-only signals and synthetic evidence are rejected.

components.name: Sri Lanka Public-Signal Lead Intelligence
components.purpose: Primary Google ADK application for evidence-backed Sri Lankan non-tender lead intelligence.

environment.configuration_status: local default with explicit cloud gate

evidence.detail: Exported Google ADK App named sl_trigger_leads.

limitations: Live model calls and provider-backed searches require separately configured credentials.

components.name: UK and Ireland D365 Search Agent
components.purpose: Search public web sources for Dynamics 365 evidence without treating source publishers as buyer accounts.
limitations: The direct grounded search provider remains the normal live discovery path.

components.name: D365 End-Customer Extractor
components.purpose: Resolve end-customer identity from supplied public evidence while preserving partner and source-company separation.
limitations: It does not browse or create new facts.

components.name: D365 Classification Reviewer
components.purpose: Perform opt-in, proposal-only review of deterministic UK and Ireland D365 classifications against supplied evidence.

environment.configuration_status: model may be selected by environment

limitations: It cannot silently rewrite deterministic policy.

components.name: D365 Opportunity Vetter
components.purpose: Convert retained public-evidence candidates into bounded 1BT opportunity assessments and explicit rejection decisions.

environment.configuration_status: model may be selected by environment

limitations: Model-backed vetting is an explicit paid/live gate.

components.name: D365 Report Composer
components.purpose: Create evidence-safe report blueprints and PDF-ready specifications from vetted UK and Ireland D365 packs.

environment.configuration_status: local deterministic composition with optional live model

limitations: An ADK response is not proof that a file was generated; the local runner must create the artifacts.

components.name: UK and Ireland D365 Root Agent
components.purpose: Orchestrate evidence-backed Dynamics 365 discovery, identity resolution, classification review, vetting, and report composition.

evidence.detail: Exported root_agent named uk_ie_d365_leads with five sub-agents.

limitations: Tender and private LinkedIn sources are excluded from lead evidence.

components.name: UK and Ireland Dynamics 365 Lead Intelligence
components.purpose: Separate Google ADK application for public-evidence Dynamics 365 account discovery, vetting, and reporting.

environment.configuration_status: local default with optional Google Cloud backbone

evidence.detail: Exported Google ADK App named uk_ie_d365_leads.

limitations: It is a separate application lane and is not automatically the root of the deployed Agent Runtime.

components.name: Business Intel Public HTTP Utilities
components.purpose: Provide shared safe public-HTTP behavior used by the repository agent packages.

evidence.detail: First-party shared HTTP package included in local and Agent Runtime source closure.

components.name: Local Runtime JSON Store
components.purpose: Persist mutable lead bootstrap data, notes, and application state outside the source tree using locked atomic JSON updates.

evidence.detail: Runtime data directory resolves outside the repository.

limitations: Runtime content is intentionally excluded from Git, wheels, and this catalog.

components.name: Local FastAPI Operator API
components.purpose: Serve authenticated local lead, source, notes, classification, fit-preview, refresh, and health APIs.
limitations: The Python service binds to loopback and is not the Hostinger deployment.

components.name: Local Business Intel Operator Workspace
components.purpose: Provide the authenticated browser dashboard for verified leads, sources, notes, classification, and service-fit previews.
limitations: This local UI is distinct from the Hostinger Node adapter.

components.name: Hostinger Opportunity Radar Adapter
components.purpose: Reimplement the Business Intel web contract for Hostinger's managed Node.js runtime without replacing the Python ADK applications.

evidence.detail: Hostinger adapter boundary and release contract.

limitations: It mirrors the operator contract but does not execute the Python Google ADK application.

components.name: 1BT Opportunity Radar
components.purpose: Expose the Hostinger-hosted relationship-intelligence and opportunity-radar interface over HTTPS.
limitations: HTTP 200 and health metadata prove availability, not every authenticated workflow.

components.name: Hostinger Opportunity Radar Deployment
components.purpose: Package and release the exact Hostinger Node adapter with production configuration supplied outside Git.
limitations: The root HOSTINGER_DEPLOYMENT.md file is an unsupported historical draft, not this release path.

components.name: Google Agent Runtime Deployment
components.purpose: Update the single approved Business Intel Google Agent Runtime with exact-target, update-only controls and an explicit Python 3.13 dependency closure.
commands: uv run --extra agent-runtime python tools/deploy_agent_runtime_exact.py preflight
uv run --extra agent-runtime python tools/deploy_agent_runtime_exact.py status
uv run --extra agent-runtime python tools/deploy_agent_runtime_exact.py smoke

evidence.detail: Approved runtime identifier and rollback metadata.

limitations: The runtime was cataloged from reviewed source metadata rather than a fresh live status call.
The Sri Lanka App is the deployed root; the UK and Ireland package is included in the source closure, not exposed as a second runtime.

components.name: Local Gmail Test Sender
components.purpose: Provide an OAuth-backed, tightly restricted local Gmail smoke path while refusing sales outreach.

evidence.detail: Explicit Gmail safety and recipient restrictions.

limitations: No email was sent during catalog creation.

components.name: Public Web Evidence Providers
components.purpose: Fetch, recover, normalize, and retain public-source evidence for lead and contact workflows.
limitations: Provider availability and public pages can change between runs.

components.name: Northwind CRM
components.purpose: Receive reviewed UK and Ireland company intelligence through an exact-project, atomic Firestore synchronization workflow.

evidence.detail: Pinned project, database, workspace, validation, and atomic sync.

limitations: HTTP availability does not prove authenticated CRM data access.

evidence.detail: Canonical parent workbook structure, format, and preservation contract.

components.name: LinkedIn Sales Navigator Evidence Intake
components.purpose: Provide authenticated, DOM-evidenced target and mutual-route inputs for resumable workbook builders.

evidence.detail: Stable-ID evidence and deterministic Google Sheets request generation.

environment.configuration_status: preflight by default; apply is explicit

evidence.detail: Declared dataset, table schemas, bucket, and fail-closed apply flag.

evidence.detail: Evidence, logs, outputs, runtime data, and secrets are excluded from Git.

components.name: Former-Client Adjacency Prospecting

environment.configuration_status: offline plan generation; explicit Sheet apply

components.name: UK and Ireland D365 Lead Pipeline
components.purpose: Discover, retain, deduplicate, identify, review, and vet public-evidence Dynamics 365 account candidates across bounded rounds.

environment.configuration_status: saved evidence by default; live searches explicit

evidence.detail: Candidate lifecycle, evidence, provider, and final-output contract.

components.purpose: Validate a vetted lead pack and dry-run or atomically add or enrich the exact Northwind CRM company collection.

components.name: Exact Agent Runtime Control
components.purpose: Preflight, update once, inspect status, and smoke-test only the approved Google Agent Runtime.
commands: uv run --extra agent-runtime python tools/deploy_agent_runtime_exact.py preflight
uv run --extra agent-runtime python tools/deploy_agent_runtime_exact.py deploy
uv run --extra agent-runtime python tools/deploy_agent_runtime_exact.py status
uv run --extra agent-runtime python tools/deploy_agent_runtime_exact.py smoke

evidence.detail: Update-only runtime command with create-path refusal and one-operation state.

limitations: Deploy is a consequential live action and is never part of catalog refresh.
